lines.en: I make my way over to the park to see what Otoha’s up to and, as always, I...I don't know. I...hang out with her, I guess?
lines.zh: 我走到公园去看看 Otoha 在干什么，而一如既往，我……我不知道。我……大概就是陪她待一会儿吧？

lines.en: She's one of the few teenagers around here that I don't have some sort of {i}connection{/i} with yet. So, all things considered, good for her.
lines.zh: 这一带她是少数几个我还没跟她建立起某种{i}联系{/i}的青少年之一。所以，总的来说，这对她来说是好事。

lines.en: But {i}more{/i} things considered, I wonder why I keep going out of my way to be around her despite our current status as “good acquaintances.”
lines.zh: 但{i}再{/i}多想想，我好奇自己为什么会一直特意绕路去跟她待在一起，尽管我们目前的关系不过是"还不错的熟人"。

lines.en: I mean, it's not as if I want that to {i}change{/i} at this point, right? So what sense is there in raising one more chicken if I'm just going to have to slaughter it?
lines.zh: 我的意思是，到了这一步我也并不想让那种关系{i}改变{/i}吧？那么，如果最后还得多宰一只，我干嘛还要再多养一只鸡？

lines.en: I'll be the first to admit that I still want to fuck that princely aura right out of her, so maybe it's something as simple as that.
lines.zh: 我第一个承认，我还是想操她，把她身上那股王子般的气质操出来，所以也许就是这么简单。

lines.en: Or maybe I'm just getting high on the fact that there's someone around here who doesn't see me as her god.
lines.zh: 又或者，我只是因为有这么一个人不把我当成她的神，而有点上瘾。

lines.en: I join her on the bench and remain silent as she talks about her morning, sparing no details in describing her strange encounters here.
lines.zh: 我在长椅上坐到她身边，沉默地听她讲她这个早上，事无巨细地描述她在这里遇到的那些奇怪遭遇。

lines.en: With the increase in foot traffic brought on by this infinite spring, she's been making more money off her music.
lines.zh: 随着这个无尽的春天带来的人流增加，她靠音乐赚的钱也多了起来。

lines.en: She offers to use some of it to buy me lunch, but I politely decline and ask her if she'd rather have sex with me instead because it's cheaper.
lines.zh: 她提出要用其中一些请我吃午饭，但我礼貌地拒绝了，并问她是否更愿意跟我上床，因为那样更便宜。

lines.en: She politely declines and says she would rather sew her vagina shut.
lines.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了，并说她宁可把自己的阴道缝起来。

lines.en: She's smarter than her friends. I'm glad she gets to live forever.
lines.zh: 她比她的朋友们聪明。我很高兴她能永远活下去。
